question: Why are the powers unrestricted for the one resting in pure consciousness?
premises: There is one whose relish is repose in surging consciousness alone.
That state has the capacity for all naming.
From that capacity, the powers are unrestricted.
inference: Because pure conscious repose entails the capacity to name all, its powers operate without restriction.
plain_english: For the one who relishes repose in surging consciousness alone, the powers are unrestricted because of the capacity to name everything.
